test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following:

 
 

 a) 
 National Highwaysy
 i)
 Zila Parishad
 
 

 b) 
 State Highways 
 ii) 
 State Public Works Department
 
 

 c) 
 Border Roads
 iii) 
 Central Public Works Department
 
 

 d) 
 District Roads
 iv) 
 Border Roads Organisation
solution:
The correct answer is **(a) - (iii), (b) - (ii), (c) - (iv), (d) - (i).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Highways** are maintained by the **Central Public Works Department (CPWD).**
 
• **State Highways** are maintained by the **State Public Works Department (PWD).**
 
• **Border Roads** are maintained by the **Border Roads Organisation (BRO).**
 
• **District Roads** are maintained by the** Zila Parishad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CPWD** is responsible for the c**onstruction and maintenance of government buildings, roads, bridges, and other infrastructure projects**.

 
 
• It works **under** the **Ministry of Urban Development(MoUD).**
 
• It was **established in July 1854 **by** Lord Dalhousie** to execute public works. He also set up the Ajmer Provincial Division.
 
 
 
• **PWD **is responsible for the **construction and maintenance of state highways, major district roads, and other infrastructure projects in the states.**
 
• **BRO** is responsible for the** construction and maintenance of roads and bridges in border areas** of India.
 
 
• It is a statutory body **under** the ownership of the **Ministry of Defence(MoD).**
 
• It was** formed on 7 May 1960**
 
 
 
• The Zila Panchayat or **District Development Council or Zilla Parishad** or District Panchayat is the third tier of the Panchayati Raj system and functions at the district levels in all states.
 
 
• The members of the State Legislature and the members of the Parliament of India are members of the Zila Parishad. 
 
• The chairmen of all the Panchayat Samitis under the district are the ex officio members of Zila Parishad.
 
• It is headed by a president and a vice-president.
 
• **District Roads are maintained by the Zila Parishad.**
